title: Summary profiles
description: Named sets of summary sections that a meeting can be summarised with instead of the Transcript Summary prompts. A meeting with no summary profile, or the profile default, is summarised with the Transcript Summary prompts exactly as before. Each profile's sections use the same form: a title, with a number in front that orders the sections, and a prompt that uses the same placeholders ({transcript}, {timed_transcript}, {agenda}, {context}, {checklist} and the others). Choose a meeting's profile when starting or scheduling a Virtual Participant, on the meeting page, or when regenerating its summary.
appliesText: A saved change applies to summaries generated within about five minutes of the save; Regenerate on a meeting page uses it at once.

label.title: Label
label.description: The name people see when they choose the profile.

description.title: Description
description.description: What kind of meeting the profile is for.

structuredActionItems.title: Structured action items
structuredActionItems.description: Make one more model call that lists the meeting's action items, each with its owner and due date as said in the meeting, and show them as a table on the meeting page.

prompts.title: Summary sections
prompts.description: The sections of a summary written with this profile. Use {transcript} or {timed_transcript} where the transcript goes. A section that names {agenda}, {context}, {checklist}, {slides} or {chat} is written only for a meeting that has one.
